messages.snippet: Maya, Now it's signed, the settlement computation in the folder sets out the payroll treatment: PILO
messages.subject: Hollis — payment instruction and tax treatment
messages.plaintextBody:
Maya,

Now it's signed, the settlement computation in the folder sets out the payroll treatment: PILON and bonus through payroll with tax + NIC; the first £30,000 of the combined statutory redundancy and ex gratia free of tax; the balance of the ex gratia taxed at source. Total gross cost to the Company, including the £750+VAT costs contribution and the £200 covenant consideration, is £208,600. Please diarise payment by 27 February and pay Ashworth Quinn's costs invoice directly.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
